title: echo-vision-fm: a pre-training and fine-tuning framework for echocardiogram video vision foundation model
core_idea: Pre-train a video encoder on large-scale unlabeled echocardiogram videos using a high-ratio masked auto-encoding self-supervised strategy, and refine learned representations with a spatial-temporal fusion network (STF-Net) that integrates joint and disjoint space-time features to produce robust, transferable video representations for downstream echocardiogram tasks.
tldr: Develop a self-supervised, video-based foundation model for echocardiograms that combines masked auto-encoding pre-training on large unlabeled datasets with a spatial-temporal fusion network to enable end-to-end, transferable representations for automated cardiac image analysis.
